I told Dana in a thread on their #north-team message that the deadline is **20 November**.

The date comes from Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 Oct. Dana is a member of that channel, so they could see it too. I couldn't find any later change in that channel or in the brain. The brain search is keyword-only, so it could miss a note that uses different wording. It's a signing date, not a money figure, so posting it in the channel is fine.
